scope: Pending from batch 90: with the agent on, «quiero una arepa rellena», «quiero 1 arepa rellena», «me das una arepa rellena» and «quiero pedir una arepa rellena» went to the model instead of the direct add; a plain side arepa ordered alone («dame arepas fritas») did the same
trigger: Gap found while writing the batch-90 spec
baselineFindings: Real router, synthetic menu, agent on: the four phrasings above → «¿Cuál prefieres?» with an empty cart; «una arepa rellena», «dame una arepa rellena», «quiero dos arepas rellenas» and other dishes («quiero una lasagna mixta») were added

Root cause: isLikelySideOnlyProduct treated any name starting with «arepa» with up to three words as a side, so nestWouldAddDirectDishOrder only accepted it with an explicit add verb matched by looksLikeExplicitAddProductRequest
With a filled arepa on the menu, «dame arepas fritas», «quiero unas arepas fritas» and «dame una porción de arepas fritas» (a real side product) also went to the model
Agent off: all phrasings were already added
fix: isLikelySideOnlyProduct: an arepa is a side only when its name is «Arepa(s)» followed solely by plain-portion descriptors (blanca, frita, asada, de maíz, sencilla, pequeña, redonda, tela); «Arepa Rellena», «Arepa De Pollo» or «Arepa Mixta» are dishes. nestWouldAddDirectDishOrder: a side product whose name is the whole message after an order verb, quantity and «porción de» is a direct order; «con/sin/y <side>» keeps the existing path.

menus: filled arepa + fried arepas side + juice
chicken arepa + white arepa side + pasta + soda
mixed arepa + plain «Arepa» side + ceviche + lemonade
contrasts: the catalog keeps the plain arepa as a side
a price question about the dish does not add it
«sin <side>» on a dish already in the cart does not add the side

validation.focused: 2533 passed (39 suites: specs mentioning arepas, portions or side-only products, and agent specs)
